title: Austin's 1876 Tax Roll Approved with Minor Corrections
summary:
• **Tax Roll Approved**: The city council reviewed and approved the tax assessment roll after identifying and agreeing to correct several errors in the records.

• **No Public Complaints**: Despite advertising the meeting for ten days to invite citizen input, no complaints were filed against the tax assessments.

• **Administrative Corrections**: The mayor agreed to make necessary adjustments to fix errors found in the tax roll before final implementation.
transcript:
19

The following called meeting
having been Advertised ten days by Posters being put up in various portions of the City.
Called Meeting of the City Council
May the 16th 1876
Called for the purpose of hearing Complaints and receiving Tax Roll. Present His Honor the
Mayor in the Chair. The Roll called Aldermen present, Aldermen
Palen, Gonschke, Collins and Fox, Rolls examined, No complaints made, Some corrections of
errors were considered necessary, which His Honor the Mayor agreed to have made, Otherwise
the Rolls were approved

a O. Stone
Recorder
